## What changed

Explain the problem and the change in plain language.

## How it was tested

List the checks you ran. If controller behavior changed, include the controller model, connection method and before and after measurements. Do not include a serial number or another device identifier.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] Public features were checked in desktop Chrome or Edge.
- [ ] Controller behavior was tested on real hardware, or the missing hardware test is stated clearly.
- [ ] No serial number, USB path or other device identifier is included.
- [ ] Experimental tools remain unavailable on the public site.
